Hey everyone, I found it, the wrongest post on BlueSky today.

Stephen Miller's financial disclosures have some glaring issues.

The WH said everything was fine.

Judge Reyes says if the parties do not consent, she will conduct the inquiry herself. 

She says she has not made a judicial finding as to whether misconduct occurred, the investigation will determine that.

For our non-lawgeek friends, a "special master" is a judicially-appointed officer with specific powers derived from the appointment. This would be by consent of the parties. 

Judge Reyes is identifying statements that she believes were false or made to mislead the court.

Judge Reyes proposes to appoint a special master to conduct an investigation into agency and attorney misconduct and ethical violations, including false statements and failing to correct false testimony.

I'm sorry, she's reading too quickly for me to relay it. 

The gist is that she believes that professional misconduct has occurred here as well as violation of Department policies.

Judge Reyes is turning to "counsel's conduct during these proceedings." 

This was prepared in advance. She's reading from it. She's reading from the code of professional conduct again. (Drink)
